_readme: Curated research on every significant building surrounding Union on 24th (701 W 24th St). Used by scripts/fetch_reference_imagery.py to download reference images, and by the desktop image-analysis workflow. true_height_m is the best real-world estimate; snapshot_height_m is what the baked 2026-07-11 data says (LiDAR flights predate the new towers, so several are badly wrong). confidence: high = multiple corroborating sources, med = single source or inferred, low = candidate/uncertain.

subject.name: Union on 24th
subject.block: South side of W 24th, Rio Grande <-> Pearl block (address numbering: Nueces=500s, Rio Grande=600s->700s at 24th, Pearl=800s, San Gabriel=900s). Union fills the NORTH half of the block; The Standard fills the SOUTH half of the SAME block. VERIFIED via photos + footprint geometry.
subject.facade: VERIFIED from photos (rhodepartners_00.jpg catches Union with signage): dark bronze-brown panel grid with prominent cream/white boxed window surrounds, dark podium. (Earlier 'light gray-white' guess in hero_designs.json is wrong.)

tier1_adjacent.name: The Standard at Austin
tier1_adjacent.block: SAME BLOCK as Union - south half, fronting W 23rd, with its podium corner at 23rd & Pearl (street sign visible in humphreys_00.jpg). VERIFIED.
tier1_adjacent.snapshot_note: BAKED HEIGHT WRONG - stale pre-2021 LiDAR. Needs hero_override ~57 m.
tier1_adjacent.architect: Humphreys & Partners Architects (won SHB Best Architecture & Design 2022)
tier1_adjacent.facade: VERIFIED from photos: 5-story podium + 17-story tower; charcoal-gray and cream/limestone panels in a dashed/striped pattern, rust-orange accent bands at balconies, glass corner bays, rooftop terrace.

tier1_adjacent.name: Villas on 24th
tier1_adjacent.address: 2313 Rio Grande St (block bounded by W 24th / Pearl / Rio Grande)
tier1_adjacent.block: Directly E across Rio Grande St from Union (E side of Rio Grande at 24th, 600-block). In the ~2023 aerial its footprint is the excavation site with tower crane - footprint assignment VERIFIED.
tier1_adjacent.snapshot_note: BAKED HEIGHT BADLY WRONG (class default) - tower opened Fall 2025, after LiDAR. Needs hero_override ~100 m.
tier1_adjacent.developer: Villas Student Housing; acquired by Core Spaces (largest single-asset student trade of 2025)
tier1_adjacent.units: 199 units / 670 beds; 275,000 sf; 2 below-grade + 3 above-grade parking levels + 25 residential levels
tier1_adjacent.facade: VERIFIED from photos: white geometric precast panel grid with irregular window rhythm, glass-crowned top floors, dark faceted podium.

tier1_adjacent.name: Regents West at 24th
tier1_adjacent.block: W across Pearl from Union: north half of the Pearl <-> San Gabriel block, fronting 24th, address on San Gabriel corner (2401).
tier1_adjacent.snapshot_note: VERIFIED from aerial overlay: the snapshot footprint labeled 'The Mark Austin' here is a 6-story full-block courtyard building with pool - that massing matches Regents West (2012, 233 units), NOT the 17-story Mark. OSM mislabel CONFIRMED.

tier1_adjacent.name: The Mark Austin
tier1_adjacent.block: SW of Union: south half of the Pearl <-> San Gabriel block, fronting W 23rd (812 = east/Pearl end of that frontage). The 25.3 m footprint at -97.7467,30.2871 with furnished roof-amenity deck is its podium; LiDAR likely caught the tower mid-construction (built 2023).
tier1_adjacent.snapshot_note: Built 2023 (post-LiDAR) - snapshot height stale; and the 'The Mark Austin' NAME in the snapshot sits on the Regents West block. Needs hero_override ~55 m on the correct footprint.

tier1_adjacent.name: HillTop Austin
tier1_adjacent.block: NW of Union: W side of San Gabriel just N of 24th (drone photo shows the 24th & San Gabriel signs at its corner).
tier1_adjacent.snapshot_note: Built 2020, mostly post-LiDAR - nearby baked heights (~10-13 m) are stale; use ~26 m.
tier1_adjacent.facade: VERIFIED from drone photo: 8-story white/cream body with dark bronze vertical tower feature and rust-orange recessed balconies, over a 2-story red-brick retail podium with a 2nd-level pool deck; historic limestone/wood storefront preserved next door on 24th.
